import os

    """Extract multiple-choice answer (A/B/C/D) from trace."""
    boxed = re.findall(r'\\boxed\{([^}]*)\}', text)
    if boxed:
        ans = boxed[-1].strip().upper()
        if ans in ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D'):
            return ans

        r'[Tt]he answer is\s*\(?([A-D])\)?',
        r'[Aa]nswer:\s*\(?([A-D])\)?',

            tasks = [self._generate_single_arc(prompt, i) for i in range(k)]

            top_p=self.top_p,
